sentences.text: This appeal is filed by the appellant-claimant challenging the judgment and award passed in MVC No.286/2013 dated 19.08.2014 by the Prl. Senior Civil Judge and AMACT, Dharwad, for seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.
3.
The occurrence of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant, coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.
4. In the present case, from the medical evidence on record it is proved that the claimant had suffered the following injuries.

i) Fracture of 5th, 6th and 7th ribs on right side ii) Left Frontal Bone Fracture (Large area of Hemorrhagic contusions) NC:
2023:KHC-D:14809 5.

The tribunal has awarded compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads. Amount in  No. (Rs.)
 1. Pain and suffering.
2. Loss of Amenities 30,000-00
3 . Loss of Income during laid up 4,500-00  period
4. Medical Expenses 42,000-00  5. Food and Nourishment 2,000-00  6. Loss of Conveyance 2,000-00
7 . Attendant Charges 3,000-00

Total: 1,13,500-00 Babu S/O Bhairu Adulkar vs The Managing Director on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97267942/
2 6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering the nature of injuries sustained,
compensation awarded by tribunal is lesser side.
Therefore, the same is required to be enhanced by modifying the judgment and award.

7. Considering the injuries sustained, a compensation of Rs.40,000-00 towards pain and suffering,
Rs.50,000-00 towards loss of amenities are awarded.
The compensation awarded towards medical expenses and hospital charges of Rs.42,000-00 is as per the actual bills and receipts produced

;
therefore, the same is kept in tact.

Further, NC: 2023:KHC-D:14809 Rs.15,000-00 towards incidental expenses like food, nourishment, traveling, attendant charges, etc., and Rs.14,000-00 (Rs.7,000X2) towards loss of income during laid up period for a period of 2 months, is awarded.

8. Thus, the claimant is entitled for total compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads.

Amount in  No. (Rs.)
 1. Towards injuries, pain and 40,000-00  suffering.
 2. Towards medical expenses.
Towards loss of amenities.
Towards loss of income during 14,000-00  laid up period and medical  treatment period.

5. Towards incidental charges like 15,000-00  attendant charges, food,
nourishment, conveyance, etc.,.
 Total: 1,61,000-00 9.

Therefore, the claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.1,61,000-00, along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of filing of the petition till realization, as against Rs.1,13,500-00 awarded by the Tribunal.
The Insurance Company is directed to deposit NC: 2023:KHC-D:14809 the compensation within eight weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.

10. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
